entities.name: GDF15
observations: In PMID 25093616, intracellular interaction with MMP26 was reported to promote processing and maturation of pro-GDF15 in trophoblast-related models.
Human placental studies report trophoblast expression and secretion of GDF15/MIC-1, but do not establish that secretion requires MMP26.

entities.name: MMP26
observations: PMID 25093616 reported intracellular binding to GDF15, validated by yeast two-hybrid screening, co-immunoprecipitation, and immunofluorescence.
The reported MMP26 enzymatic activity was required for pro-GDF15 processing/maturation in the studied models; dependence of secretion or total GDF15 production was not established.

entities.name: HTR8/SVneo
observations: Human extravillous-trophoblast-like cells were used in PMID 25093616 to evaluate the functional consequences of the MMP26–GDF15 interaction.

entities.name: PMID:25093616
observations: Qiu et al., JCEM 2014: reported intracellular MMP26–GDF15 interaction and MMP26 enzymatic dependence of pro-GDF15 maturation in trophoblast-related models.
The retrieved evidence does not document MMP26 perturbation with extracellular GDF15 release measurements or a definitive rescue design.

entities.name: PMID:11134143
observations: BeWo trophoblastic cells constitutively expressed and secreted MIC-1/GDF15, measured by transcript analysis and sandwich ELISA; MMP26 dependence was not tested.

entities.name: PMID:15601912
observations: MMP26 was localized in human placental trophoblast populations, with developmental expression changes; this was correlative and did not test GDF15 interaction.
